blocks.text: Anvil jobs are submitted with sbatch. Every Anvil job must request an account and partition.

Partition | Maximum walltime
shared | 345600 seconds
wholenode | 345600 seconds
Anvil requires an ACCESS allocation before jobs can be submitted. CPU work is charged against ACCESS service units.
Files in Anvil scratch that have not been accessed for 60 days may be purged.
Negishi jobs require a site-specific QoS value.
